title: Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Fight Back Against The Moon! 🌕 ~ Flight in the Bamboo Cutter ~ Lunatic Princess (Remix)
description:
𝒯𝒽𝑒 𝒽𝓊𝓂𝒶𝓃 𝒷𝑜𝒹𝓎 𝒽𝑜𝓊𝓈𝑒𝓈 𝒶 𝒻𝓇𝒶𝑔𝒾𝓁𝑒 𝓈𝑜𝓊𝓁...
𝒯𝒽𝑜𝓈𝑒 𝒷𝑜𝒹𝒾𝑒𝓈 𝓁𝒾𝓋𝑒 𝓊𝓅𝑜𝓃 𝒶 𝒽𝓊𝑔𝑒 𝓈𝓅𝒽𝑒𝓇𝑒.
𝒜𝓃𝒹 𝓋𝒶𝓁𝓊𝒶𝒷𝓁𝑒 𝓅𝑒𝑜𝓅𝓁𝑒 𝓁𝒾𝓋𝑒 𝓊𝓅𝑜𝓃...
𝒯𝒽𝒶𝓉 𝓁𝓊𝓃𝒶𝓇 𝑜𝓇𝒷 𝒷𝑒𝒽𝒾𝓃𝒹 𝓂𝑒.
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ- Kaguya Houraisan, 2004

Did an arrangement of Flight in the Bamboo Cutter ~ Lunatic Princess from Touhou 8 Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night. This song... not only is it one of my favorite boss themes in the series, it's also one of my favorite final boss themes of all-time!!! Always been a massive simp for this song ever since I first heard it in Touhou 8 and have been wanting to arrange this song for years now. But I thought I'd actually base this arrangement off Saitama Saisyu Heiki's two arrangements of this track. Some of my favorite arrangements of the amazing track and one of my favorite doujin artists period. I thought it'd be cool to make this a semi-tribute to them.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
